title: Multi-dataset target lock-in and structure-based drug repurposing for chronic postsurgical pain
description: Computational reproducibility package for the CPSP (chronic postsurgical pain) DRG-spinal-axis target-lock-in and approved-drug repurposing study. It integrates public transcriptomic datasets across the dorsal-root-ganglion and spinal-cord axis (cross-dataset Stouffer meta-analysis, dual-machine-learning hub-gene prioritisation, single-cell localisation) with structure-based virtual screening of the ChEMBL max_phase=4 approved-drug library (3,085 unique drugs) against ten tractable hub targets using AutoDock Vina, under an explicit control-based validation framework: docking-parameter fidelity, independently labelled (ChEMBL) enrichment, molecular-weight confounder control (size-only and 2D-physicochemical baselines with paired delta-AUC confidence intervals), and a reportable face-validity test. Code, derived ranking tables, breadth/enrichment summary tables, and figures are included. Raw prepared ligand/receptor structures are excluded (regenerable from documented ChEMBL SMILES and RCSB PDB IDs); the consolidated docking-score table (P6_docking_scores_merged.csv) is the screen output of record.
